answer-identity.description: The answer is no longer bound to the selected question.

citation-integrity.description: A citation reference, path, scope, URL or digest changed.

proposition-integrity.description: An expected proposition or its declared gold value changed.

schema-contract.description: The answer no longer satisfies the closed JSON Schema contract.

snapshot-integrity.description: The corpus or temporal snapshot binding changed.

source-set-integrity.description: The exact required source set changed.

unclassified-diagnostic.description: The verifier emitted a diagnostic outside the pinned taxonomy.

new_category_rate_denominator: distinct non-critical categories discovered in this pass

protocol.diagnostic_classification: Independent-verifier diagnostics are classified without consulting mutation intent.
protocol.mutation_discovery: Seed-ranked property mutations discovered from each answer's actual required fields, propositions, citations and evidence bindings; no fixed six-case replay.
protocol.name: okf-corpus-navigation-challenge-discovery

review_boundary: This is an internal deterministic property challenge of corpus-navigation answers and the fail-closed verifier. Held-out means disjoint from calibration and the other pass, not secret or blinded from the deterministic answer generator. It is not a model-assisted review, human legal challenge, legal-answer evaluation, or qualified legal assurance.

selection.method: domain-separated immutable-input seed, hash ranking and all non-held-out persona-task calibration rows
